title.narrative: Stöd till INE:s undersökning om livsvillkor
Support to INE:s life survey in Guatemala

description.narrative: Insatsen avser att stödja den guatemalanska statistikmyndigheten INE genom att dels bidra till INEs genomförande av den landsomfattande undersökningen av fattigdom och livsvillkor i Guatemala (ENCOVI) via ett avtal med organisationen "La Asociación de Investigación y Estudios Sociales" (ASIES) som tillser att INE har fordon och bränsle för dessa fordon för att under november 2014 till och med januari 2015 genomföra arbete i fält. Vidare ska genom en tjänsteköpsöverenskommelse med Statistiska centralbyrån, Statistics Sweden (SCB) från Sidas ramavtal med sagda myndighet finansieras en diagnos för möjligheterna till ett mer ingående och i tiden långvarigt samarbete mellan SCB och INE för att stärka INE institutionellt och tekniskt.

The contribution aims to support the Guatemalan statistical office INE by contributing to INE´s implementation of the country-wide survey of poverty and living conditions in Guatemala (ENCOVI) through an agreement between Sida the organisation "La Asociación de Investigación y Estudios Sociales" (ASIES) to ensure that INE has vehicles and fuel for those vehicles that during November 2014 to January 2015 conduct fieldwork. Furthermore, through a Service Purchase Agreement with Statistics Sweden, (SCB) from Sida's framework agreement with said agency fund a diagnosis for the possibility of a more detailed and in time long-term cooperation between SCB and INE with the purpose of strengthening INE institutionally and technically.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Through the Swedish funding INE has been able to perform field work on a department level in order to get more adequate information on poverty and living conditions which has added up to a more comprehensive national survey on living conditions, ENCOVI, providing the Guatemalan government with a better tool to plan for combating poverty and strengthen development in the country.
Seminars, travels and discussion between INE and Statistics Sweden (SCB) have been performed and implemented according to plan, and has resulted in a mutual project document on institutional cooperation between the two parties. This cooperation is currently in its inception phase and is planned to lead to a four-year long capacity-building within the INE through the support of SCB.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
